title: Pompeii Wardrobe Opens After Almost 2,000 Years
paragraphs: Pompeii is an old city in Italy. A volcano buried it in the year 79. Today, experts study its houses.
In one house, experts found a wooden cupboard. It was closed for almost 2,000 years. They opened it and told people in October 2026.
Inside, there was a necklace with at least 24 small charms. There were also 38 bronze coins and a small perfume bottle. The family may have left in a hurry.

questions.q: How long was the cupboard closed?
How many bronze coins were inside?
